candidates.review_note: Legendre v5(n!) equals sum of base-five digit d_j times (5^j-1)/4; this coefficient has parity j. Tight digit DP counts even valuation among0..n, including0!.

Represent every prefix uniquely by a nonnegative number of complete blocks and a prefix of length0..n-1. Solve x=block_count*balance+prefix_balance; zero balance produces either no solutions or infinitely many.

Store total, maximum nonempty prefix, suffix, and subarray in a segment tree. Range-query accumulation preserves left-to-right order and uses None as an empty identity, avoiding an incorrect zero answer for all-negative ranges.

Odd original cells keep their labels. Undo the compaction of an even target cell by mapping x to n+x/2 repeatedly until reaching an odd original cell, whose original label is (x+1)/2. Each inversion shrinks the remaining distance to2n.

Track only incremented cells. A descent can only start at an incremented cell; check that count[j]<=1+count[j+1]. If all adjacent differences are nonnegative, movement cost telescopes to the final minus first value.

Scan the stream while retaining markup mode across lines. Always recognize the mode toggle; otherwise remove only documented commands when enabled, preserving unknown escapes and exact text/newlines. Font-size numbers allow leading or trailing decimal points.

Plaintext excludes digits, so a digit-only line is unambiguously ciphertext. Reverse it before parsing ASCII: allowed character codes starting with1 are three digits, all other codes are two digits. Preserve plaintext spaces.

Rectangular monochromatic components are equivalent to every row being one fixed binary row or its complement: a three-equal 2x2 would form an invalid corner. If more than K rows exist, one is unchanged, so try existing rows; otherwise transpose if needed or enumerate at most2^K patterns. Sum minimum row distances.

The minimum attainable longest unwatched run is the longest forced-N run; the maximum is the longest run with no forcedY. Flipping unknown positions one at a time establishes every intermediate longest-run value, so test the interval includingK=0.
